subject: POC trial planning - success criteria & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Ethan Park <ethan@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: POC trial planning - success criteria & next steps

Hi John / Sara - great to speak earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we're all aligned before kickoff: 

Summary of what we heard (from today's discovery)
- Primary goal: Reduce time-to-insight for customer support reps by surfacing relevant KB snippets and suggested responses (target: 30% faster resolution)
- Success criteria: 1) Precision@3 >= 75% on our evaluation prompts, 2) Average response latency <= 350ms for 256-token responses, 3) No PII leakage in generated content during evaluation
- Scope: In-scope channels: internal KB + recent tickets (30k training subset); out-of-scope: external public web scraping during trial

Proposed evaluation plan
- Ramp: 1-week ingestion & infra prep; 3-week trial with weekly check-ins; final readout with quantitative results and handoff artifacts
- Milestones: Kickoff (week of Mar 1), Week 1: data ingest + smoke tests, Week 2: metric tuning & user sample, Week 3: readout prep + final readout

Ownership (Redwood / Acme)
- Redwood: Marissa (AM, logistics & timelines), Ethan (SE, integration & infra), Lauren (CS, success metrics & end-user samples)
- Acme: John (product owner), Sara (engineering lead)

Kickoff options
- Proposed: Week of Mar 1 - suggested slots Tue 3/2 or Wed 3/3, 10:00-11:00 PT (30-45m)
- Weekly check-ins: same day/time, 30m standups to review progress and blockers
- Final readout: tentatively Fri 3/26 10:00 PT

Attachments: POC-Scope-Acme.pdf (scope + checklist), MVP-Eval-Checklist.xlsx (metrics & prompts), draft kickoff agenda attached.

Immediate asks for Acme before kickoff
1) Confirm preferred kickoff date/time (3/2 or 3/3)
2) Provide a 1% sample of anonymized ticket data (or dataset access method)
3) Create a test SSO account or a dev SAML connector we can use for SSO smoke tests

I'll hold 3/2 10:00 PT on my calendar pending confirmation.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole

- Please share a 1% sample of tickets as a CSV or S3 link (anonymized). If you can't share CSV, we can connect to a staging database read-only.
